name: Ruth King
reason: Skipped under the owner's 5 Nov rule on political-centred content, as a judgement call for the owner to confirm: her whole site (ruthking.net, robots.txt allows us) is now the Mindful of Race Institute, and every pathway, training, coaching offer and publication is centred on racism and racial conditioning, with the home page framing racism as 'a heart disease' that is 'curable'. She is an insight meditation teacher, and a contact form exists (an embedded Google Form on ruthking.net/contact-us-2/), so if the owner decides racial-awareness dharma work is not political commentary she could be researched in full.
